target_customer: Solar plant owners, developers, asset managers and operators
problem: Solar plants lose output to hidden faults and degradation; operators lack tools to isolate causes of underperformance and prevent downtime.
business_model: B2B SaaS and per-plant analytics subscription

founders.name: Govinda Upadhyay
education: Studied in Sweden, the Netherlands, Switzerland and India (per YC page)
previous_startups: Serial entrepreneur in the climate domain (YC page, no names)
founders.background_notes: Background in physics, smart electrical systems and climate change per YC page. Company started in Switzerland in November 2019 per an EQ Mag Pro interview.

founders.name: Neeraj Dasila
prior_employers: TATA (product manager, connected vehicles and electric mobility)

competitors.name: Raptor Maps
competitors.what: Drone-based solar inspection and anomaly analytics
competitors.traction_then: Had analysed over 20 GW of solar PV by mid 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Isolating the cause of PV underperformance from current, voltage and weather data needs physics models plus machine learning, with messy plant data.

defensibility.rationale: Data from many plants can compound, with a company claim of 25 billion data points, but monitoring vendors and inverter makers can add diagnostics.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent absorbing the wedge; the company continues to sell and has expanded to battery storage and an AI agent.

market_need_then: Solar capacity was growing fast, and the 2020 Swiss funding report framed demand for diagnostic and prescriptive tools to extend plant lifespan.

branding.name_origin: Helio comes from Helios, the Greek sun god, per founder Govinda Upadhyay in an EQ Mag Pro interview; he also describes the aim of being doctors of solar plants.

identity.visual_style: Energy tech, product names GAIA and Autopilot
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, with the plant doctor metaphor

branding.brand_signature: The plant doctor idea and the sun-god name
branding.community_and_virality: Founder profiles in TechCrunch, EQ Mag Pro and Unreasonable Group, and pv magazine coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful name with steady trade press, but a niche B2B audience limits awareness.

pivots.from: Solar PV diagnostic tool for plants
pivots.to: AI agents (GAIA) and platform covering solar and battery storage
pivots.why: Not stated; product expansion visible on the current company site.

outcome_analysis: SmartHelio began in Switzerland in 2019, raised a small Swiss round in 2020 and a five million dollar seed in December 2022 around its YC batch. Its site claims 8 GW under management, but those figures are unverified, and the YC page cites 3 GW and 40 developers. Further grants are reported by aggregators. With 25 staff and no exit, it looks stable with modest capital.
notes: The 2020 round was CHF 250,000 per pv magazine India headline coverage via a search summary; recorded with null amount because the CHF to USD conversion is not sourced; page itself was not read. Founder Upadhyay later said it was a mix of equity and convertible loan. Seed of $5M in December 2022 is stated by startupticker, venturelab, techstartups and Nordic9; the investor list is from search summaries. Aggregator totals conflict ($5.17M to $6.96M) and include grants; a $1.5M grant of March 2024 is aggregator only and unverified. Company site claims differ from YC page (8 GW vs 3 GW). Power Factors was seen only in undated directories, so not listed.
